'''Glowdarts''' were small insectoids native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. They had a symbiotic relationship with the indigenous [[sloat]], a snake-like creature. Glowdarts were used to break into [[Traygura]]'s base by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]].
